title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
summary: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.
body: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布研究报告，探讨企业如何通过ChatGPT和Codex等工具采用智能体AI（Agentic AI），并分析前沿企业在AI实际落地和业务执行中的领先经验与转型实践。原始信息显示：OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work”。其重要性主要体现在：文章展示了企业如何应用智能体技术进行从辅助到自主执行的转变。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
